title: Advance federation sender recovery fairly when a retained-intent worker exits without a result
outcome: Prevent a deterministic worker panic or lost oneshot result from pinning the sender-recovery cursor to one retained intent and starving later rows, while preserving exact identity, idempotent retry and storage-error semantics.
acceptance: A sender recovery worker that exits without sending its completion cannot monopolize every later recovery pass; later retained intents make bounded progress without discarding the failed row's durable intent.

A deterministic controlled-worker-exit regression distinguishes the dead-worker path from ordinary retryable storage or transport errors and proves later-row progress with shutdown ownership retained.
The focused check and project-required review/gate evidence cover the resulting source before completion.
